messages:
clare_ng: heads up — vendor advisories just dropped for multiple inference libs (protobuf, flashattention kernel, sentencepiece). needs triage and patch window.
ajay: linking the advisories?
clare_ng: https://vendor.example.com/advisory/protobuf-2025 and https://vendor.example.com/advisory/flash-kernel-2025
clare_ng: protobuf CVE-2025-3456 (remote deserialization), flash kernel CVE-2025-8765 (out-of-bounds in optimized kernel), sentencepiece CVE-2025-2222 (parsing edge case).
sarah: are there PoCs?
clare_ng: protobuf has a PoC in the advisory, kernel one is a limited exploit in specific CUDA+kernel combos, vendor says 1% of our fleet (old image variants).
ajay: immediate priority = protobuf and kernel. protobuf is easy patch/test, kernel needs rebuilt flash kernels and integration test on Triton/vLLM stacks.
ev an: assigning owners: ajay -> protobuf & vLLM package bump, marcus -> flash kernel rebuild & Triton test images, evan -> KMS/RBAC/audit checks for rollout approvals, sarah -> canary monitoring and rollback runbook.
marcus: ETA for rebuilt kernel images? I can spin today but need ~6 hours to compile and run microbenchmarks on p4/p100 variants.
ajay: protobuf patch is a one-line dependency bump in our base images. I can push a hotpatch container in ~2 hours and run smoke tests.
ev an: we need audit trail for the hotpatch rollout. @sec-bot please ensure KMS key usage is logged and approvals captured.
sec-bot: noted — enabling explicit approval workflow for deployments tagged HOTPATCH, writing audit event to s3://redwood-audit/inference/1967123456.json
clare_ng: RBAC note: we must ensure the deploy pipeline service account can't auto-promote to prod without 2 approvals for HOTPATCH. Evan can you add that policy?
ev an: I'll add a temporary policy requiring two approvers in the deploy pipeline (ops+security) for HOTPATCH. Will also rotate the API key used by the legacy deploy step.
sarah: monitoring checklist: pre-rollout baseline of p50/p95 latency, token-error-rate, 5xx rate, and GPU memory OOMs. Canary for 5% traffic for 30m, then 25% for 1h, then full.
marcus: test plan snippet:
```
- build flash-kernel v2.3.1-fix
- run unit tests (kernel correctness)
- run Triton inference smoke on p4 and a100
- run vLLM end-to-end with seed prompts and correctness hashes
- run perf scripts and compare to baseline
```
ajay: protobuf plan:
```
- bump protobuf to 4.21.13 in base image
- run packaging job `ci/build-base-image --tag hotpatch-proto`
- run integration tests in staging (chat, embeddings, batch inference)
- promote to canary
```
sarah: what about sentencepiece? priority lower but still patchable. open PR exists?
clare_ng: yeah PR #412 in our fork; we can fold into the next non-urgent deploy window unless we see exploit attempts.
ev an: timeline proposal: protobuf hotpatch in next 4 hours (canary immediately), flash kernel rebuild & canary by EOD (8–12 hours), sentencepiece in next regular deploy (48–72h).
marcus: risk: kernel change might slightly change perf. we'll measure and if >5% regression on p95 we'll rollback and fall back to CPU path for affected model variants.
ajay: fallback note: runtime supports auto-fallback to CPU-quant path if kernel fails; we should enable that policy for the canary only.
clare_ng: please add a small smoke test to verify fallback path before canary.
sarah: alerting updates: add alert on token-error-rate >0.2% and p95 latency increase >10% during rollout. Ops will be on-call for the window.
ev an: I've created an RG ticket for RBAC/KMS changes: RG-1967123456. Adding approvers: @marcus, @sarah.
sec-bot: audit entry created: RG-1967123456, action=HOTPATCH_APPROVAL_REQUIRED, keys_rotated=false
deploy-bot: CI pipeline started for hotpatch-proto (job id 58422)
ajay: CI green for proto hotpatch, pushing canary image to staging registry.
marcus: kernel build initial smoke passed on p4, perf within 2% of baseline. uploading images to staging.
sarah: starting canary: routing 5% traffic to hotpatch-proto + kernel image on dedicate-canary cluster. I'll monitor.
[some minutes pass]
sarah: canary at 5% for 30m: token-error-rate 0.03% (baseline 0.02%), p95 +1.2%, no OOMs. moving to 25%.
clare_ng: good. keep rolling. please keep an eye on error logs for deserialization exceptions (protobuf).
sarah: no deserialization errors observed.
ev an: RBAC policy deployed. pipeline now blocks auto-promote for HOTPATCH.
marcus: 25% hold: perf stable. moving to 100% in 45m if no regressions.
sec-bot: audit log updated with rollout checkpoints.
deploy-bot: Production deploy started for hotpatch (job id 58422)
clare_ng: thanks everyone. follow up: create post-incident note summarizing timeline, CVEs patched, and any config changes (RBAC/KMS). assign to me and evan.
ev an: will draft RBAC/KMS summary. ajay/marcus please add links to PRs and image sha digests in the notes.
ajay: PRs: proto-fix #409, kernel-rebuild #410. image shas: sha256:aaa111..., sha256:bbb222...
marcus: note: schedule a runbook update to include kernel-rebuild checklist and perf guardrails.
clare_ng: closing: last check at 1967123580 — all good, no incidents.
